goalDescription: Die lernende Person kann das Marktmodell auf konkrete Beispiele anwenden, die Koordinationsfunktion von Märkten erklären und Modellannahmen kritisch mit realen Märkten vergleichen.
reviewerModel: Codex; exact serving model identifier not exposed
aspectRatioDecision: Close native16:9 landscape; no exception needed. Format not mechanically normalized.

actualInspection.fachlichePruefung: The theoretical inset has correctly directed price and quantity axes, one rising orange supply curve and one falling blue demand curve, correctly labelled and intersecting once. Real bicycle buyers consider quality and condition, so the open model question distinguishes a simplified price/quantity account from further real-market dimensions.
actualInspection.phone: At 360 px both opposing curves, intersection, axis directions and labels remain identifiable. Buyer, seller and quality/condition thought scenes provide the main real-market context.
actualInspection.desktop: At 680 px Angebot attaches to the rising orange curve and Nachfrage to the falling blue curve; Preis and Menge are correctly located. No numerical equilibrium is invented.
actualInspection.actorPerspective: The graph is a conceptual thought bubble, not a board supposedly read backward. Product tags are publicly facing shoppers, and the working mechanic faces the wheel.
actualInspection.style: Friendly clear comic raster, coherent broad colors and approachable people without photorealism or sterile technical restyling.

interpretationLimits: The chart is a theoretical illustration, not measured market data. Different bicycle quality prompts reflection on model assumptions rather than asserting all goods are identical.
goalTextStatus: Actual current canonical German title/description inspected; no D/P gate attested by this image review.
